name: entry_requirements
description: Check the paperwork a passenger needs before they fly to the European Union / Schengen Area or the United Kingdom — the EU Entry/Exit System (EES), UK Electronic Travel Authorisation (ETA) and eVisas. This is about documents, NOT about whether travel is blocked: use disruption_status for closures and transit_rules for connections. Call this whenever a caller names a European or UK destination and asks what they need, or mentions a passport, visa, ETA or biometrics.

destination.description: Destination country, city or airport code, e.g. 'London', 'LHR', 'Munich', 'Spain'
